div.head: ECf 26.2
div.ab: Quodsi confidens in pace quam habet, per superbiam forisfecerit alicui, restauret dampnum et iterum tantumdem, quod Angli uocant a[f]trigelt [b]et[e]; forisfacturam!
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 650 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

div.ab: But if, trusting in the peace that he has, he commits an offence against anyone through pride, let him make good the damage and as much again, which the English call a[f]trigelt [b]et[e] (repayment-compensation); the fine!
